# Launchion

Launchion is an MVP development agency that helps founders launch their products in 15 days. We specialize in building high-quality, scalable MVPs using modern tech stacks like Next.js, React, and Node.js.

## What We Do
- **MVP Development**: Full-cycle development from idea to launch in 15 days.
- **Tech Stack**: Next.js, React, TailwindCSS, PostgreSQL, Supabase, Node.js.
- **Process**: Execution-first approach. No endless meetings. Just shipping.
- **Pricing**: Transparent, fixed pricing. No hidden costs.
